reference_sql:
WITH line_costs AS (
  -- one row per order line in Q2 or Q3 2025, with its cost on its order date
  SELECT s.product_id,
         CASE WHEN s.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN 'Q2' ELSE 'Q3' END AS qtr,
         s.units, s.net_revenue_eur,
         s.units * ch.unit_cost_eur AS cost_eur
  FROM sales AS s
  JOIN cost_history AS ch
    ON ch.product_id = s.product_id
   AND s.order_date >= ch.valid_from
   AND (ch.valid_to IS NULL OR s.order_date <= ch.valid_to)
  WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
),
product_quarter AS (
  -- one row per product and quarter
  SELECT product_id, qtr, SUM(units) AS v, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue, SUM(cost_eur) AS cost
  FROM line_costs
  GROUP BY product_id, qtr
),
in_both_quarters AS (
  -- one row per product sold in both quarters
  SELECT q2.product_id,
         q2.v AS v2, q2.revenue / q2.v AS p2, q2.cost / q2.v AS c2,
         q3.v AS v3, q3.revenue / q3.v AS p3, q3.cost / q3.v AS c3
  FROM product_quarter AS q2
  JOIN product_quarter AS q3 ON q3.product_id = q2.product_id
  WHERE q2.qtr = 'Q2' AND q3.qtr = 'Q3'
),
one_quarter_only AS (
  -- one row per product sold in one quarter only
  SELECT product_id, qtr, revenue - cost AS margin
  FROM product_quarter
  WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM in_both_quarters)
),
q2_unit_margin AS (
  -- one row: the Q2 margin per unit of the products sold in both quarters, and their units
  SELECT SUM(v2 * (p2 - c2)) / SUM(v2) AS a, SUM(v2) AS total_v2, SUM(v3) AS total_v3
  FROM in_both_quarters
)
SELECT 1 AS step, 'q2_margin' AS component,
       ROUND((SELECT SUM(revenue - cost) FROM product_quarter WHERE qtr = 'Q2'), 2) AS amount_eur
UNION ALL
SELECT 2, 'price', ROUND(SUM((p3 - p2) * v3), 2) FROM in_both_quarters
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, 'cost', ROUND(-SUM((c3 - c2) * v3), 2) FROM in_both_quarters
UNION ALL
SELECT 4, 'volume', ROUND((total_v3 - total_v2) * a, 2) FROM q2_unit_margin
UNION ALL
SELECT 5, 'mix', ROUND((SELECT SUM(v3 * (p2 - c2)) FROM in_both_quarters) - total_v3 * a, 2) FROM q2_unit_margin
UNION ALL
SELECT 6, 'new_discontinued',
       ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q3' THEN margin ELSE -margin END) FROM one_quarter_only), 0), 2)
UNION ALL
SELECT 7, 'q3_margin', ROUND((SELECT SUM(revenue - cost) FROM product_quarter WHERE qtr = 'Q3'), 2)
ORDER BY step

WITH line_costs AS (
  -- one row per order line in Q2 or Q3 2025, with its cost on its order date
  SELECT s.product_id,
         CASE WHEN s.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN 'Q2' ELSE 'Q3' END AS qtr,
         s.units, s.net_revenue_eur,
         s.units * ch.unit_cost_eur AS cost_eur
  FROM sales AS s
  JOIN cost_history AS ch
    ON ch.product_id = s.product_id
   AND s.order_date >= ch.valid_from
   AND (ch.valid_to IS NULL OR s.order_date <= ch.valid_to)
  WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
),
product_totals AS (
  -- one row per product sold in Q2 or Q3, with both quarters side by side
  SELECT product_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS v2,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS r2,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN cost_eur ELSE 0 END) AS k2,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q3' THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS v3,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q3' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS r3,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q3' THEN cost_eur ELSE 0 END) AS k3
  FROM line_costs
  GROUP BY product_id
),
in_both_quarters AS (
  -- one row per product sold in both quarters
  SELECT v2, r2 / v2 AS p2, k2 / v2 AS c2, v3, r3 / v3 AS p3, k3 / v3 AS c3
  FROM product_totals
  WHERE v2 > 0 AND v3 > 0
),
q2_unit_margin AS (
  -- one row: the Q2 margin per unit of the products sold in both quarters
  SELECT SUM(v2 * (p2 - c2)) / SUM(v2) AS a, SUM(v2) AS total_v2, SUM(v3) AS total_v3
  FROM in_both_quarters
)
SELECT 1 AS step, 'q2_margin' AS component, ROUND((SELECT SUM(r2 - k2) FROM product_totals), 2) AS amount_eur
UNION ALL
SELECT 2, 'price', ROUND(SUM((p3 - p2) * v3), 2) FROM in_both_quarters
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, 'cost', ROUND(-SUM((c3 - c2) * v3), 2) FROM in_both_quarters
UNION ALL
SELECT 4, 'volume', ROUND((total_v3 - total_v2) * a, 2) FROM q2_unit_margin
UNION ALL
SELECT 5, 'mix', ROUND((SELECT SUM(v3 * (p2 - c2)) FROM in_both_quarters) - total_v3 * a, 2) FROM q2_unit_margin
UNION ALL
SELECT 6, 'new_discontinued',
       ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r3 - k3) - SUM(r2 - k2) FROM product_totals WHERE v2 = 0 OR v3 = 0), 0), 2)
UNION ALL
SELECT 7, 'q3_margin', ROUND((SELECT SUM(r3 - k3) FROM product_totals), 2)
ORDER BY step

solver.query:
WITH l AS (SELECT CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS d, ol.product_id, ol.quantity AS q, ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS rev FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'),
lc AS (SELECT CASE WHEN l.d <= DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS qt, l.product_id, l.q, l.rev, l.q * ch.unit_cost_eur AS cost
  FROM l JOIN cost_history ch ON ch.product_id = l.product_id AND l.d >= CAST(ch.valid_from AS DATE) AND (ch.valid_to IS NULL OR l.d <= CAST(ch.valid_to AS DATE))),
pq AS (SELECT product_id, qt, SUM(q) AS v, SUM(rev) AS rev, SUM(cost) AS cost FROM lc GROUP BY product_id, qt),
b AS (SELECT a.product_id, a.v AS v2, a.rev / a.v AS p2, a.cost / a.v AS c2, a.rev - a.cost AS m2, c.v AS v3, c.rev / c.v AS p3, c.cost / c.v AS c3
  FROM pq a JOIN pq c ON c.product_id = a.product_id AND c.qt = 3 WHERE a.qt = 2)
, k AS (SELECT SUM((p3 - p2) * v3) AS price, -SUM((c3 - c2) * v3) AS cost, SUM(m2) / SUM(v2) AS a, SUM(v3) AS sv3, SUM(v2) AS sv2, SUM(v3 * (p2 - c2)) AS sx FROM b),
t AS (SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rev - cost), 0) FROM pq WHERE qt = 2) AS q2, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rev - cost), 0) FROM pq WHERE qt = 3) AS q3,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rev - cost), 0) FROM pq WHERE qt = 3 AND product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM pq WHERE qt = 2)) AS only3,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rev - cost), 0) FROM pq WHERE qt = 2 AND product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM pq WHERE qt = 3)) AS only2)
SELECT 1 AS step, 'q2_margin' AS component, ROUND(t.q2, 2) AS amount_eur FROM t
UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'price', ROUND(k.price, 2) FROM k
UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'cost', ROUND(k.cost, 2) FROM k
UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'volume', ROUND((k.sv3 - k.sv2) * k.a, 2) FROM k
UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'mix', ROUND(k.sx - k.sv3 * k.a, 2) FROM k
UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'new_discontinued', ROUND(t.only3 - t.only2, 2) FROM t
UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'q3_margin', ROUND(t.q3, 2) FROM t
ORDER BY step
